## Description

Ranks securities by current price relative to their trailing 52-week high; buys leaders and optionally shorts laggards.

## Where it may fit

Persistent cross-sectional momentum and slow information diffusion; portfolio breadth helps diversify single-name risk.

## Vehicles

Equity long-only, long-short equity, factor and quant funds.

## Required data

Point-in-time daily prices, trailing 52-week highs, point-in-time universe, liquidity and corporate actions.

## Caveats

Research result can be sample-sensitive; prevent survivorship/look-ahead bias and account for turnover and shorting costs.
